good_thing: (Southern California): A coalition led by San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance released more than 3,000 endangered mountain yellow-legged frogs and tadpoles into the San Bernardino and San Jacinto mountains, as reported August 21. The release carries a 20-year breeding and reintroduction effort past 10,000 animals returned to high-elevation habitat.
current_or_history: Joseph-Michel Montgolfier was born in Annonay, France, on August 26, 1740. He and his brother Jacques-Étienne came from a paper-making family and later gave a public hot-air-balloon demonstration in Annonay on June 4, 1783.
tiny_fact: A group of flamingos can be called a flamboyance. Other accepted collective nouns include a stand, colony, and pat.
thought: Small returns count too, especially when they bring a little life back to a mountain.
